source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What evidence supports a claim that the requested Skill Creator procedure was actually used?

options.text: A final message that prominently names Skill Creator
options.feedback: Naming a procedure in generated text does not establish that its instructions were loaded or its steps performed.

options.text: A skill folder with a polished title and complete instructions
options.feedback: A finished document can exist without the requested authoring procedure having been followed.

options.text: A record showing that the agent read the short catalog description
options.feedback: The description helps select a skill. Evidence of selection alone does not establish that the detailed instructions were loaded and their required steps completed.

options.text: Records of loaded instructions and completed required steps
options.feedback: Check evidence that the procedure was loaded and that its required work actually occurred, including relevant evaluation artifacts.
